ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation. High-contrast white circular pixel clusters scattered globally. Parallel high-contrast white linear pixel arrays oriented vertically on the upper-right lobe and diagonally on the upper-left lobe. Dense high-intensity cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible acute angle and vertical depth penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Notable larger indentations and peaks visible on the right lobe trailing edge distal to the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex outward curve on both lobes, sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips with an upward orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity pixel clusters (2-12 pixel diameter) distributed across the dark ventral surface of both lobes, representing localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sets of 3-5 parallel, high-intensity linear pixel disruptions located on the upper-outer margins of both lobes, consistent with rake mark patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on both lobes; extensive circular scarring; irregular, jagged trailing edge topography on the right lobe suggests previous tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white cluster and edge-irregularity at the extreme left distal tip.
